title: Take the Depositor Training Survey and Win
content: Training News 2026 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Take the Depositor Training Survey and Win 10/22 Please take this brief survey to help us better understand depositor training usage and interests. Take the survey to win stickers of images from Molecule of the Month and the Molecular Landscapes gallery of David S. Goodsell paintings. Clockwise, from upper left: Chloroplast, Red fluorescent protein, Measles Virus Proteins, Myoglobin in a Whale Muscle Cell.
